question: How many films are in the catalogue?
How many films are there for each rating?
gold_sql: SELECT rating, COUNT(*) FROM film GROUP BY rating

question: What is the average rental rate of a film?
How many rentals have not been returned yet?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rental WHERE return_date IS NULL

question: Which actor has appeared in the most films?
gold_sql: SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id GROUP BY a.actor_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT a.first_name || ' ' || a.last_name FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id GROUP BY a.actor_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many films are in the Comedy category?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film_category fc JOIN category c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Comedy'

question: Which film category has the most films?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM category c JOIN film_category fc ON fc.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.category_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which customer has made the most rentals?
gold_sql: SELECT cu.first_name, cu.last_name FROM customer cu JOIN rental r ON r.customer_id = cu.customer_id GROUP BY cu.customer_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT cu.first_name || ' ' || cu.last_name FROM customer cu JOIN rental r ON r.customer_id = cu.customer_id GROUP BY cu.customer_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which customer has spent the most money?
gold_sql: SELECT cu.first_name, cu.last_name FROM customer cu JOIN payment p ON p.customer_id = cu.customer_id GROUP BY cu.customer_id ORDER BY SUM(p.amount) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT cu.first_name || ' ' || cu.last_name FROM customer cu JOIN payment p ON p.customer_id = cu.customer_id GROUP BY cu.customer_id ORDER BY SUM(p.amount) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What was the total payment amount in July 2005?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) FROM payment WHERE payment_date >= '2005-07-01' AND payment_date < '2005-08-01'

question: Which film category generates the most rental revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film_category fc ON fc.film_id = i.film_id JOIN category c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id GROUP BY c.category_id ORDER BY SUM(p.amount) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which country has the most customers?
gold_sql: SELECT co.country FROM customer cu JOIN address a ON a.address_id = cu.address_id JOIN city ci ON ci.city_id = a.city_id JOIN country co ON co.country_id = ci.country_id GROUP BY co.country_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many films have never been rented?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film f WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory i JOIN rental r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id WHERE i.film_id = f.film_id)

question: Which film has been rented the most times?
gold_sql: SELECT f.title FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
